spans.s:
m. (-रः)
1 Union with little or no motion, as that of the fingers with one another, amphiarthrosis.
2 A bud.
E.
कुर sound, घञ् aff.

mn. (-कः-कं)
1 A bud, an unblown flower.
2 A species of perfume, commonly

Another perfume, a berry containing a resinous and fragrant substance: see कक्कोलक.
4 The fibres of the stalk of the lotus.
E.
कुर to sound, affix वुन्.

f. (-ङ्गी)
Small cardamoms: see एला.
E.
कुर to sound, अङ्गच् and ङीष् aff.

m. (-षः)
A kind of grain, (Paspalum frumentaceum.)
E.
कोर a bud, दूष to change, अण् affix; also कन् being added, कोरदूषक m. (-कः)

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Pounded, ground, comminuted.
2 Budded, sprouted.
E.
कोर, and इतच् aff.
